e.title: Credibility-Gated XAI
e.summary: 可审计 XAI 核保框架（107★）：信度门控建模 + 共形预测 + 子群验证——「黑盒 AI 如何被信任」
e.body: Credibility-Gated Underwriting XAI（107★）是可审计的 XAI 框架：商业车险核保风险评估与损失预测，信度门控建模、共形预测、子群验证与模型监控。对 RIAA：「保险 AI 必须可解释」的工程实现——监管与公平视角下黑盒模型的解法；与 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定价）、[[actuarial-pricing]]（精算定价）形成「可解释性」对照教学；培训课讲 AI 落地的信任议题。
e.verified_note: 源码核实：仓库确认（XAI 核保框架，107★），未实测
e.summary_en: Auditable XAI underwriting framework (107★): credibility-gated modeling + conformal prediction + subgroup validation — how black-box AI earns trust
e.summary_hk: 可審計 XAI 核保框架（107★）：信度門控建模 + 共形預測 + 子羣驗證——「黑盒 AI 如何被信任」
e.body_en: Credibility-Gated Underwriting XAI (107★) is an auditable XAI framework: commercial auto underwriting risk assessment and loss forecasting with credibility-gated modeling, conformal prediction, subgroup validation and model monitoring. For RIAA: an engineering implementation of "insurance AI must be explainable" — the answer to black-box models under regulatory and fairness scrutiny; with [[machine-learning-pricing]] (ML pricing) and [[actuarial-pricing]] (actuarial pricing) it forms an explainability teaching contrast; training sessions can cover the trust agenda of AI deployment.
e.body_hk: Credibility-Gated Underwriting XAI（107★）是可審計的 XAI 框架：商業車險核保風險評估與損失預測，信度門控建模、共形預測、子羣驗證與模型監控。對 RIAA：「保險 AI 必須可解釋」的工程實現——監管與公平視角下黑盒模型的解法；與 [[machine-learning-pricing]]（ML 定價）、[[actuarial-pricing]]（精算定價）形成「可解釋性」對照教學；培訓課講 AI 落地的信任議題。
